jobs.title: Strategy Manager
jobs.description:
The Strategy Manager supports strategic planning, business analysis, and cross-functional execution across key organizational priorities. This role partners with stakeholders across multiple departments to structure complex business questions, analyze data, identify trends, and translate insights into clear recommendations that support decision-making.  This individual will help structure ambiguous business questions, develop clear workplans, gather and synthesize inputs from cross-functional partners, and communicate recommendations through presentations, written updates, and verbal discussions. The Strategy Manager will work closely with leaders and business partners to drive work forward, support alignment, and ensure strategy deliverables are completed with accuracy, clarity, and pace. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem solver with strong communication skills, sound business judgment, and the ability to navigate ambiguity while driving work to completion.
What you'll do
- Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to support strategy initiatives, business planning efforts, and key projects aligned to department and organizational priorities.

- Break down complex or ambiguous business questions into structured workplans, analyses, and recommendations.

- Analyze data, identify trends, and synthesize insights to support business decisions and strategic recommendations.

- Develop clear, professional presentations, memos, and written communications for a variety of audiences, including senior leaders and executive stakeholders.

- Gather inputs from teams such as Finance, Operations, Product, Commercial, Marketing, and other business functions to help inform recommendations.

- Facilitate working sessions, project discussions, and stakeholder updates to drive alignment and move work to completion.

- Support the development of business cases, scenario analysis, market assessments, and other strategic deliverables.

- Distinguish key insights from available data and clearly communicate what the analysis supports.

- Manage priorities, timelines, and deliverables to ensure work is completed accurately and efficiently.

- Build strong working relationships across departments and act as a trusted partner in helping teams solve business challenges.

What we expect of you
- Bachelor degree and 5 years of experience in strategy, business analysis, consulting, finance, operations, corporate planning, or a related business function OR

- 9 years of experience in strategy, business analysis, consulting, finance, operations, corporate planning, or a related business function

Preferred skills, experience, and qualities needed
- Demonstrated experience structuring complex problems, analyzing information, and developing clear business recommendations.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively and professionally across all levels of the organization, including senior and executive leadership.

- Proven ability to collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders across multiple departments.

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities, drive work to completion, and adapt to changing business needs.

- Demonstrated ability to take ownership of responsibilities, navigate ambiguity, and work independently with appropriate guidance.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including PowerPoint and Excel.

- Experience working in a large corporate environment or on a strategy-focused team.

- Experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, business operations, finance, or a related strategic function.

- Foundational understanding of finance, business metrics, P&L concepts, or business case development.

- Experience developing executive-ready presentations, business updates, or strategic recommendations.

- Strong planning and execution skills, with the ability to demonstrate a strategic thought process.

- Ability to influence, collaborate, and build trusted relationships across teams.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Comfortable working through ambiguity and bringing structure to undefined or evolving priorities.

- Adaptable, coachable, and eager to learn and grow within the role.

- Experience in B2B technology, commercial strategy, operations, or an adjacent industry preferred.

Pay range: $125 ,000 - $174 , 6 00 depending on experience and skill set
Annual bonus target of 10 % subject to terms and conditions of plan
Benefits overview: https://cdw.benefit-info.com/
Salary ranges may be subject to geographic differentials

CDW is committed to being an AI-fluent organization
We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, a learner’s mindset, and a willingness to engage with ever-evolving technology and tools. We value adopting AI as a partner, openness to experimentation, and a shared interest in learning together on AI. Our goal is to create a culture where AI enhances—not replaces—human creativity and decision-making. You don’t need to be an expert today; what matters is your readiness to explore, adapt, and grow with us as we integrate AI responsibly and effectively into our work.
Additionally, CDW is committed to fostering an equitable, transparent, and respectful hiring process for all applicants. During our application process, our goal is to understand your experience, strengths, skills, and qualifications. As an AI forward company, we see AI not just as a tool, but as a catalyst for new ways of thinking, creating, and communicating. We encourage candidates to embrace an AI mindset, one that’s curious, adaptive, and ready to explore what’s possible. We welcome thoughtful use of AI to expand your perspective and elevate how you share your story, while ensuring your application remains rooted in your own background, judgment, and voice.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, FP&A
jobs.description:
Job Summary
The Senior Manager of Financial Planning & Analysis is a key leader in the Solutions & Services organization. This position is responsible for financial planning and analytical support for business partners and provides C-suite and senior management information through regular business performance reporting. The Senior Manager provides leadership, direction and management to the Solutions & Services FP&A team and owns the compilation and review of the financial plan and financial forecasts for the organization.
What you’ll do
- Thought leader for FP&A team and business segments and channels, driving ad hoc accounting and finance projects.
- Manage members of the FP&A team; providing leadership, guidance and development opportunities to increase skill set and overall business, system and interpersonal aptitude.
- Ensures that planning and budgeting practices and procedures are appropriate and continually advance the analytical toolkit used by the team.
- Own practice-level P&Ls, including reconciliation of delivery and project data from operational systems to the financials, and help drive standardization across multiple system sources
- Partner with Services FP&A team to help build and maintain core services and solutions operating metrics – backlog, utilization, attach rate, project margin, etc. – with consistent definitions and targets across practices
- Translate financial results into forward looking insights for senior leadership: what moved, why and what to watch in the future
- Provide business operations support, including month-end transaction processing and other related administrative and operational responsibilities as needed.

What we expect of you
- Bachelor's degree and 7+ years of Finance/Accounting experience with 3+ years of progressive leadership experience.
- Excellent verbal and written communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
- Strong knowledge of accounting and finance principles with the ability to apply them in business analysis.
- Experience supporting technology and/or services-centric P&Ls, with expertise in project-based revenue recognition, cost management, and operational KPI analysis, preferred.
- Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills with a proven track record of driving solutions.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities, adapt to changing business needs, and meet deadlines.
- Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel; Workday Adaptive experience preferred.
- Proven team leadership skills and ability to build productive cross-functional relationships.
- Track record of identifying process and system improvements and leading successful implementations.
- Successful history of developing and maintaining financial models.

Pay range: $ 141,000 - $ 175,000 depending on experience and skill set

jobs.description:

Job Summary
This role is to support the delivery of financial plans, financial forecasts, and the Revenue to Gross Profit FP&A processes across CDW UK & International. The role will provide timely, accurate and actionable analysis, to facilitate business partnership with Sales and Finance stakeholders. The role will also help improve the quality, consistency and automation of revenue reporting and planning.

What you will do
- Delivery of timely and accurate revenue to gross profit month-end analysis, forecast & plans.
- Delivery of accurate performance insight for Sales leadership, Finance Business Partners, UK Executive & Group stakeholders, with material risks and opportunities identified and communicated to finance and non-finance stakeholders early.
- Contribute to the delivery of departmental and consolidated monthly business review outputs, supported by effective stakeholder management & challenge.
- Improved forward visibility through enhanced deal pipeline analysis, with a drive to improve forecast accuracy & support the Head of Revenue with multi-year planning.
- Driving consistency through engagement with FBPs & executive stakeholders delivering behavioural change and report standardisation.

What we expect of you
Minimum basic requirements
- Produce timely and accurate month-end analysis (during and post-month-end) and support consolidated and departmental Monthly Business Review materials for Group, the UK Executive and Finance stakeholders.
- Produce and improve departmental revenue to gross profit analysis, standardise reports and planning tools, reducing manual intervention and duplication of effort.
- Support the Head of Revenue in the maintenance and development of the three-to-five-year strategic plan through engagement with Finance Business Partners and business leaders.
- Support competitor and market analysis for MBR and senior leadership discussions.

Preferred skills, experience, and qualities needed
- CIMA/ACCA/ACA qualified or equivalent.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, spanning internal and external stakeholders, including senior leadership.
- Ability to explain complex finance concepts to non-finance stakeholders, with the ability to translate data into practical insight.
- Highly motivated with a track record of advancement and development within their role.
- Meticulous planner & impeccable track record meeting deadlines.
- Continuous improvement mindset, comfortable challenging the status quo.
- Advanced user of Microsoft Excel & PowerPoint.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
The Senior Program Manager leads the planning, coordination, and execution of complex programs in support of Marine Corps Installations Command (MCICOM), including Military Construction (MILCON) and Installation Communication Grid (ICG) initiatives. This role is responsible for managing the full lifecycle of infrastructure and telecommunications programs, ensuring alignment with mission requirements, technical standards, and program objectives. The Senior Program Manager serves as a key interface with senior stakeholders while driving cross-functional collaboration to successfully deliver large-scale programs.
What you will do
• Manage MILCON and ICG programs from initiation through planning, execution, and closeout, ensuring alignment with mission requirements and Marine Corps standards
• Lead program planning and execution activities across multiple initiatives supporting MCICOM
• Oversee scheduling and milestone management, including development and maintenance of Integrated Master Schedules (IMS)
• Provide schedule oversight to ensure alignment of project milestones, deliverables, and critical path activities
• Coordinate planning across engineering, logistics, financial, and operational teams
• Manage cross-program resource allocation to optimize personnel, funding, and materials
• Identify program risks and support development of mitigation strategies and risk management plans
• Oversee program performance tracking, including metrics development, analysis, and reporting
• Partner with engineering teams and SMEs to ensure technical alignment and successful delivery
• Lead stakeholder engagement with Marine Corps leadership, installation personnel, and external partners
• Support change management activities impacting program execution
• Oversee project validation and prioritization to align initiatives with mission and strategic objectives
• Coordinate requirements development and ensure alignment with operational and infrastructure needs
• Support issue resolution to maintain timelines and ensure successful execution
• Develop program roadmaps, including long-range planning and capability development
• Provide milestone and deliverable forecasting to support leadership decision-making
• Conduct or support risk assessments and integrate findings into program planning
• Support resource planning and cross-functional coordination across all program elements
• Assist in development of Concepts of Operations (CONOPS) and future system requirements
• Provide input into long-term budgeting and outyear planning efforts
• Ensure effective stakeholder coordination across all supported installations
What we expect of you
• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Program Management, or a related field and Minimum of 15 years of experience in program or project management supporting federal or defense programs OR 10 years with a Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
• Demonstrated experience managing MILCON and/or ICG programs with end-to-end lifecycle ownership
• Extensive experience with scheduling, milestone tracking, and Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) oversight
• Strong background in risk management, resource allocation, and performance tracking
• Experience coordinating across engineering, logistics, financial, and operational teams
• Familiarity with Department of Defense processes and infrastructure program management
• Experience engaging with senior-level stakeholders in a federal or defense environment
• Proven ability to manage competing priorities across multiple complex programs
• Strong leadership, organizational, and decision-making capabilities
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level briefings
• Active Secret clearance required
• Must be a U.S. Citizen
• Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is a plus
• Master’s degree in Program Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or related field is a plus
• Experience supporting Marine Corps Installations Command (MCICOM) is a plus
• Strong familiarity with Installation Communication Grid (ICG) architecture and telecommunications infrastructure programs is a plus
• Experience supporting MILCON programs, including DD Form 1391 development and infrastructure modernization initiatives is a plus
• Knowledge of Planning, Programming, Budgeting, and Execution (PPB&E) processes is a plus
• Experience developing program roadmaps, CONOPS, and long-term capability strategies is a plus
• Experience working with NAVFAC, USACE, DISA, or other Department of Defense stakeholders is a plus.

Pay range: $180,000 – $240,000 depending on experience and skill set.
Benefits overview: CDW Benefits
Salary ranges may be subject to geographic differentials.
